text: Here is the practical answer: Executives drafting in their own voice with AI comes down to a few decisions. First, collect a handful of pieces you are happy with and treat them as the standard. Second, write down what makes them yours as short, checkable rules rather than adjectives. Third, review a week of drafts against those rules and fix the cases that still miss one at a time. Teams that skip the examples step tend to keep editing every draft by hand.
